name: Kimi Plus

price.note: $19 a month, or $180 a year ($15 a month). China: ¥99 a month.

check.label: Kimi Code console, or /usage in the CLI

meters.label: 5-hour window
meters.hint: Kimi Code console, or /usage in the CLI

reset.rule: A rolling 5-hour window. Your limit recovers on its own as the window moves on.
stipulations: The Kimi CLI, VS Code, Desktop and third-party tools draw on one quota. So do all your logged-in devices and API keys.
k3 uses about 2x the quota of k3-256k. HighSpeed models use about 2x as well.
Kimi doesn't publish a request count for any tier.
About 300 to 1,200 requests per 5 hours across tiers, with up to 30 at once (third-party report, unconfirmed).

reset.rule: Resets at the start of each billing cycle.
stipulations: Shared between Kimi on the web and app and Kimi Code.
When it runs out, Kimi Code is frozen until the reset or until you upgrade.
Unused quota doesn't carry over. Kimi doesn't publish the amount.
There is no weekly limit on current plans.

overage: Extra Usage is off by default. Turn it on to keep going after the plan quota, billed in RMB by actual use (about ¥0.03 for a simple request, about ¥1.6 for a complex task). A monthly spend cap is optional; without one there is no cap. Top-ups are at least ¥25, and the balance doesn't expire and isn't refundable. A "Buy Extra Usage" button appears at 80% used.

how: Kimi Code is part of the Kimi membership. There is no separate Kimi Code subscription.
A rolling 5-hour window and a monthly total. Whichever runs out first stops you.
Models: kimi-for-coding (K2.8 Preview, up to 1M context), k3-256k, k3 at 256K context, and K3.1 Pro (thinking only, default effort high).
ext: Claude Code: set the base URL to https://api.kimi.ai/coding/ (Anthropic-compatible). Nothing else is needed.

Codex, OpenCode and other OpenAI-compatible tools: https://api.kimi.ai/coding/v1, with Chat Completions and Responses. Kimi also documents Trae, Hermes Agent, and JetBrains and Zed through the Kimi CLI's ACP.
quirks: Changing your client's User-Agent counts as a violation and can suspend your membership benefits.
Devices unused for more than 30 days are unbound. Run /login to restore one.
You can make up to 5 API keys in the Kimi Code console. Each is shown only once.
The pay-as-you-go Moonshot API at api.moonshot.ai is a separate product and doesn't use this plan.

Members from before the September 2026 relaunch may still be on a legacy plan, which also has a weekly window that resets 7 days from the subscription date. Switching is optional; an upgrade is prorated and takes effect at once.
Annual billing is available at a lower monthly rate.
